full_prompt_en: A square acrylic-like painting shows a fantastically colored bird in an extreme close-up, its large yellow eye dominating the left-center of the frame. The background is almost entirely replaced by jostling blocks of hot pink, orange, turquoise, green, violet, white, and dark blue, so the subject and its surrounding color field interlock. Near the upper left, thick navy lash-like strokes project over the eye. The round iris glows lemon yellow and orange around a dark blue-black pupil, with small pale reflections on its glossy surface. A broad blue brow and dark contour frame the eye against adjacent magenta and coral planes. On the right, a pointed beak-like form is built from turquoise, coral, ivory, and a deep navy underside. The lower and left areas carry curved bands of orange, pink, lime, and violet, broken by small triangles, dots, and irregular dabs. Larger off-white and light green patches on the lower right provide a moment of relief within the dense color. Brush marks are visible as short loaded strokes and scraped edges; some shapes end abruptly in dry paint while others are outlined in nearly black. There is little conventional depth, yet the dark pupil, brow, and beak recess make the face project from the flat patchwork. Light is bright and broadly frontal, reflected most sharply in the eye and on the pale color blocks, while the deepest blue strokes create local shadow. A small signature-like mark appears near the lower left but is not legible enough to transcribe. The overall composition is exuberant and tightly cropped, using a single luminous eye to stabilize a crowded rhythm of saturated, tactile color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近似丙烯质感的绘画呈现一只奇彩鸟的极近特写，巨大的黄色眼睛主导画面左中部。背景几乎被炽粉、橙、青绿、绿色、紫、白和深蓝色互相推挤的色块取代，主体与周围色域咬合。左上方粗厚的藏蓝色睫毛状笔痕伸过眼睛。圆形虹膜在深蓝黑瞳孔周围发出柠檬黄和橙光，光亮表面有细小浅色反光。宽阔蓝色眉部与深轮廓将眼睛框在邻近洋红和珊瑚色平面前。右侧尖形喙状结构由青绿、珊瑚、象牙白和深藏蓝底面拼成。下部与左侧有橙、粉、青柠绿、紫色的弯曲条带，夹着小三角、圆点和不规则点痕。右下方较大的灰白与浅绿斑块为浓密色彩提供短暂的缓冲。短促而带颜料厚度的笔触与刮擦边缘清晰可见；有些形状以干涩颜料骤然结束，有些则被近黑色勾边。传统纵深很浅，但暗瞳、眉部与喙的凹处使面部从平面拼块中凸出。光线明亮且宽泛地从正面照来，在眼中与浅色块上反射最强，最深蓝色笔划形成局部阴影。左下附近有一处签名状小记号，但不够清楚，不能转录。整体构图欢腾且裁切紧密，以一只明亮眼睛稳定饱和、可触色彩的拥挤节奏。
style_prompt_en: A saturated acrylic-like painting packs irregular color blocks and short loaded strokes into a tightly cropped field. Hot magenta, coral, citrus yellow, turquoise, lime, violet, and navy all remain distinct, with small pale patches providing relief rather than muting the palette. Strong near-black contours and a few concentrated dark cores hold the arrangement together; surrounding shapes break into triangles, curves, dots, and scraped dry edges. Some pigment appears thick and matte, while selected smooth highlights create a glossy focal sparkle. Depth is shallow but not flat: overlap and deep recess colors bring one core form forward from the patchwork. Lighting is bright and broadly frontal, with local shadow created by dark paint masses rather than a single cast-shadow direction. The composition is dense, rhythmic, and boldly asymmetrical, its energy coming from color collisions and visible handwork.
style_prompt_zh: 高饱和、近似丙烯的绘画把不规则色块和短促饱含颜料的笔划压进紧密裁切的画幅。炽洋红、珊瑚、柑橘黄、青绿、青柠绿、紫和藏蓝各自分明，少量浅色斑块提供呼吸，却不削弱色盘。强烈近黑轮廓和少数集中的深色核心维系排列；周围形状碎成三角、曲线、圆点和干涩刮边。有些颜料厚实哑光，选定的平滑亮点则制造光亮的焦点闪烁。空间很浅却并不扁平：遮叠与深凹色使核心形体从拼色中向前凸出。照明明亮且宽泛地从正面来，局部阴影由深色颜料团块制造，而非单一投影方向。构图浓密、有节奏且大胆不对称，能量来自色彩碰撞与可见手工笔迹。
theme_en: A close-up of a fantastically colored bird with one large yellow eye
theme_zh: 一只奇彩鸟的特写，硕大的黄色眼睛醒目
name: 花彩肖像拼贴画法
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
